newsitem.title: THAILAND: Four people killed in pre-dawn fire near Bangkok.
newsitem.headline: Four people killed in pre-dawn fire near Bangkok.

text.p: A fire killed four people living above a shop on the southern outskirts of Bangkok on Tuesday, police said.
The fire broke out in the early hours of the morning in a four-storey building where about a dozen workers were sleeping on upper floors, police said.
Two people who jumped to safety were taken to hospital with serious injuries, police said.
Police said the blaze, which firemen took 30 minutes to put out, was under investigation.
